notes.title: Hellsplit: Arena 1.24.1 update and future of the game Steam version
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/7633bd45c021e216d6ae48cbcc96758b8716c08d.png"]
Hello, brave Warriors! ⚔️
Hellsplit developers are back with you again. First and foremost – we want to apologize for our long silence. As you may know, earlier this spring we released Hellsplit: Arena for mobile VR headsets. It also took us some time to roll out patches and fix various issues.

At the moment, we’re in an unusual situation: we now have two versions of the game, and the mobile version is actually ahead of the PC version in terms of content and mechanics. Right now, we’re fully focused on bringing the PC version of Hellsplit: Arena up to date. Once both versions are synced, we plan to release future updates for both platforms simultaneously.

We’re aiming to release this major update on Steam in the first half of autumn. A more detailed announcement will follow later this summer.
Oculus VR native support
Today, we’re rolling out a small, but important update. As some of you may have noticed, the Steam version of Hellsplit: Arena has only supported one VR runtime all these years – SteamVR. This has occasionally caused issues when playing on Quest headsets.

With this update, we’ve added support for OculusVR – the native runtime for Quest headsets. This should help reduce various compatibility issues. You’ll now be able to choose the runtime environment when launching the game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/d13534a9625a0151e868507c15a285fb7f7aeb94.png"]

We’ve also fixed a few long-standing bugs.
Changes
Added native OculusVR support for Quest headsets

Fixed a bug where weapon scale could change after sheathing it in a slot

Fixed a bug where your hand could get stuck in the shield after dropping it

Improved item-throwing mechanics

Fixed a bug where the Rifle with bayonet would start floating after stabbing

Fixed a visual bug where altar meshes would overlap each other

The biggest changes are still ahead. We’re actively working on bringing all the new mechanics over to the PC version – and the long-awaited major update on Steam is coming soon.

Thanks for staying with us! ⚔️

notes.title: Hellsplit: Arena Meta Quest Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/af6c4ae5849f7d9598c123736f37ae4a586553bd.jpg

Hello, friends!

We are back with the good news from Hellsplit-world!

The entire year 2024 we have worked hard on porting Hellsplit: Arena to Quest platform and are glad to announce that the release version is almost ready. The game is planned to be released in February 2025.
We have tried to keep everything you already love in our game and added a lot of new features to prepare a really fresh release for you!

You can already add Hellsplit: Arena to the wishlist here meta.com/experiences/hellsplit-arena/28290645160526730

Quest version includes the update 1.25. And here are the main features:

 Updated and modified "Arena" campaign
 A lot of new enemies, including Meatboy
 A lot of new enemy animations, attacks and movesets
 Roleplay system that allows you to build your character
 New combat mechanics with friendly units
 New weapon, armor and interactive objects
 System of quests
 Overhauled sound, new sound engine and many other changes

The game will be compatible with all present versions of the Quest headsets (apart from Quest 1).

Plans after the release on Meta Quest
In spite of the solid age of Hellsplit: Arena, the developers intend to continue supporting their project. Soon after our release on Quest we plan to add following features:

 Mods full support on Quest
 New enemies and equipment
 New game mode "Sandbox"

The future plans on Steam version
In spite of the fact that the Quest port took up a lot of our effort and time, the update of the PC of the game remains to be the priority task for us. This spring we plan the major update of the PC game version on Steam, but first we want to make sure that the new mechanics work properly. Aside from the above-mentioned features this update will also include the native support of Meta Quest headsets. Further on we will try to update all the game versions simultaneously.

Thank you for your support and see you very very soon!

notes.title: Hellsplit: Arena 1.3, Quest Release and Future Plans
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/56fde262bfc37a89c1b0cbcaf25de1882d52cebe.png
Hello Warriors!

Devs are here with you again and today we want to share our plans, ideas and visions with you on the future of the game Hellsplit: Arena.

As many of you know, our game was first released on Steam in late September 2019. It is a rather long time, but the fact that remains unchanged is that all this time we have been working and continue working on our game. All this time we have considered the requests and wishes of our players with great attention and we managed to gradually integrate many of those (e.g. mods) to the game. In parallel, we always had our own vision on the project and desire to implement plenty of ideas, new mechanics, modes, etc. Unfortunately our team remains practically as small as it was at the game start. For this reason we have never had an opportunity to implement all conceived at the very beginning but it only means that each of us works even harder to make Hellsplit: Arena just as it was initially planned to be. And today we are glad to announce that we came as close as possible to our goal and want to tell what the future holds for Hellsplit: Arena:

Hellsplit: Arena 1.3
Hellsplit: Arena 1.3 is a core update which basically includes all the vision of the creators gained through years of development. Moreover the update takes numerous requests of our players into account linked to replayability of the “Arena” campaign, addition of new enemies to the game, fixing of the old problems and integration of new mechanics:

Core changes:
Updated “Arena” campaign
In general the “Arena” campaign will keep its structure and the maps set, but it will be expanded by means of more detailed revelation of LORE part, new gameplay elements, global goals and plenty of new enemies. There will be added new game modes NG+, additional endings as well as the possibility to return to the previous maps. Besides, the starting classes will appear in the game, which will help you to comfortably begin and continue with the exactly weapon builds that you like. Obviously there will be added new weapon types to the game which will make the fight even more varied and help you using your unique fighting style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/335512ac519bff26959be9c9628e136903cf146f.png

New campaign “Labyrinth”
“Labyrinth” is a principally new campaign which earlier was not presented in our game. The participants of our community Un_Cocotier and Shadow Team under official support of the developers are engaged in the development of this campaign. “Labyrinth” will represent 9 unique biomes, each of which consists of 2 procedurally-generated levels, where at the end of each you will  face a boss in a fight! During the adventure you will be able to find new loot, open new weapon, pump your character and many other. The mode with also support several NG+ modes, where passing of each can take of 10 hours. We will share more details about the new mode in one of the next announcements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/81e875735d2301b1292e0250e2b7dee4548c4460.png
New game mode “Sandbox”
The mode that has already become classic in many famous VR games. Here everything is familiar to you - you will be able to spawn the characters, weapon and other objects in real time as well as change their properties and behavior. You will be able to collect all the content which is presented in the game on one level and different configurations. Now all this will appear in our game as well.

Overhauled enemies pipeline
We have always paid particular attention to the enemies and interaction with them in our game. Those who have followed us for long know that we have some characters (e.g. Meatboy) that have been ready for a long time and still have not appeared in the main game. Now their time has come and they all challenge you in the update 1.3. You will find more than 10 new enemies, including non-anthropomorphic, with blood and rich dismemberment, just the way you like! Besides, the existing enemies will also be overhauled to divide their classes more clearly. Bosses will get their personal styles and ultimate possibilities to really challenge you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/e6a353821db33d099859d78be69ca5e0743777d2.png

Simplified role-playing system
It is a brand new mechanics in our game which enables the progression of your character. Some players were worried that the addition of RPG part will lead the game away from the initial idea of realistic Melee fighting, but we assure you that there is no reason for concern. The role-playing system by no means changes the fighting mechanics but rather complements them, e.g. adding the critical damage to the weapon which allows you to fight the enemies of any complexity level using your most preferable weapon. Our game is and will be based on the Skill Based Combat System. Besides, the system will include suchlike classical characteristics as luck, chance of loot drop and objects search, which become critically important in combination with the updated “Arena” and “Labyrinth” modes, as now for passing them it will be strongly important to find and collect the key playing objects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/69404ad7eb300e0a2a50a454529b5125109efbdf.png

Avatar’s customization system
Another system which has not been presented in our game earlier. Now it will help you to customize your character by setting its appearance using a variety of unique presets. Race, skin color, hair, facial hair, tattoos - you will be able to change all this to set your exclusive character.

Overhauled sound system
Amongst many of the reviews to our game, there are a good few of those where you have reported about the sound low quality. We have always acknowledged this problem but unfortunately could not start its solving for a long time. Now we have finally found the resources to take up this issue, so for several months already the game’s sound system has been in the process of overhauling. We are polishing almost everything from the creation of the distinctive ambient effects for each map to the selection of new, high-quality and various samples for sounding of all the interactive elements in the game. We have quite closely worked on the binaural effects settings which is very important for every VR game. We hope that you will not be disappointed! We also intend to replace the announcer! 🙂

Global UI refinement
The addition of new role-playing systems requires us to include new gaming interfaces and windows! The existing system has become common and classic but, after 5 years, we want to slightly update it. Nothing will be principally changed but the interface will become a bit more modern.

Multi-language support
At present our game supports only English, though the addition of other languages has been in our plans for long. Finally, in the update 1.3 it has become possible to add new localizations into the game. We will announce the full list of the new languages later.

Fixing of critical problems
Since the release of our game there have been accumulated a lot of problems that are reported again and again by people. Black screen at launch, game crashes at the start, broken savings - all this is critically important, but unfortunately we still have not managed to solve the majority of these problems, mostly due to the difficulties of hardware and software interaction of VR systems. We will try to fix the biggest part of those problems in the new update. Moreover, we do not forget about other promises of ours, e.g. the new control modes for Touch controllers (Quest) and Steam achievements will be added.

Update 1.3 will be released at the beginning of Q4 2024. Until then we do not plan to release any other updates as we are now throwing all our forces in the new release! In case you missed the previous news, our update 1.24 was released 3 weeks ago, in which we added some interesting improvements.

Quest 2 и Quest 3 Releases
We have long thought about the order of the news in our announcement. It is true, our game will be released on the Meta Quest platform and this is a remarkable event for our game, perhaps even more significant than the release of another big update.

The game released on the Quest platform will include the entire content which is available on the PC version and will be endowed with the same possibilities. Obviously, the hardware difference of the platforms will lead to the graphics level differences, but the game will have the same gameplay possibilities as the main game. The same enemies, weapon and maps will be presented in the game at the time of launch.

We initially plan the release for Quest 2 platform, which will be definitely supported on Quest 3 devices, but with the same graphics level. We plan to release a separate game version a bit later, specifically optimized for Quest 3 using the AR possibilities of the new platform. The release on the Quest platform is planned for Q4 2024.

Sony PlayStation VR2 Release
It’s long been rumored on the web that we plan to release our game on PSVR2 platform. And yes, it’s not a rumor! We are really working on porting of our game to this platform. The game the same will be released in an updated version there, including the update 1.3 and special optimizations which will use the capacities of the modern VR device by Sony to the maximum. The release of this update is planned for Q2 2025. More details will follow in one of the next announcements!

Other Platforms
We are still full of ideas regarding the future development of our game and the Deep Type Games studio itself. The release on other platforms, apart from the above-mentioned is among them. We do not reveal the details so far, as we need to concentrate on the current plans and launch the new releases in the specified deadlines.

Conclusion
We end our announcement here but not the development of the game Hellsplit: Arena. We still have a lot of plans. Such possibilities as multiplayer or the “Siege” mode as well as many others were not included in the update 1.3. But this is all possible in the future if there is the most significant - the support of our players! The fact that you like our game, play it, follow it, share your wishes and really care about its future is very important for us. We are here with you, we love you and hear you, read every review, keep all of your ideas and note each of your suggestions down. This game is for you!

We hope that you enjoyed this announcement and our future plans regarding our game’s development! Follow our news, subscribe to our Discord and wait for the new updated and releases on the new platforms! Good luck, warriors!

Yours sincerely, Deep Type Games team.

notes.title: Hellsplit: Arena 1.24 update and our future plans
notes.notes:
Hello, Friends!
We are back again and would like to share our fresh news with you! Our absence was related to the preparation for the global Update 1.3, which is intended to make the game Hellsplit: Arena just as we wanted it to be for all these years. New game modes, large amount of new enemies, brand new gameplay mechanics - you will see all this very soon! Moreover, we have another great news for you which will be announced really soon! 🙂

We are also glad to present our new Update 1.24. In this update we have been basically concentrated on the Inventory mechanics. which has been added to the game. The addition of the Inventory represents a preparatory step before we introduce new game modes which will be available in the next update.
Currently you can use the inventory both in the campaign mode and in the training mode, to experience the new gameplay and interact with the objects in a brand new way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/ae8764703294a60494dc4c6a32c793a1a8c56040.gif

Besides, we have added our bosses to the training mode, so now you will be able to call them for training fights.

We have also added subtitles and many other useful improvements to the game.

The situation with achievements
As some of you already know, when working on the achieves we have made a mistake in the settings which led to the complete unlockage of the achieves by some people. 
We are very sorry for this mistake. 
So as we want all our players enjoy their achievements, we are planning to reset the achieves progress before the next update 1.3. In  the update itself the functionality of the achieves will be completely restored and every player will be finally able to open them.

The Update 1.24 will be the last regular update before the release of the global Update 1.3. We will make an announcement about this update next week already. Stay in touch, fight the undead and see you very very soon!

Changes

The inventory is added
Now the transition to the Pause menu is done through the inventory
The presets for calling the Bosses-enemies are added to the Altar
Bosses are added to the training presets Hard and Extreme
Filters for modding content are added to the Altar
Subtitles are added to the game cutscenes and opening words (you can disable it in options)
Subtitles configuration is added to the game options
It is now possible to disable the automatic weapon approach in the options
Haptic feedback is added when the player's hand is near the slot
It is now possible to put the weapon magazine in the slots behind the back
The images in the game menu are replaced
Bug with the crash on the Armory map when using the bow is fixed
Bug with the game crush when downloading the mods while the download speed drops is fixed

notes.title: Hellsplit: Arena Update 1.22 released
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/1718df4f084b8b6bfff4ec386dd1e2fa217f366b.png
Hello, Friends!
The Deep Type Games developers are here again and we have come with a new update!
Lately, we've been putting a lot of effort into developing tools for creating mods, but we've also always kept in mind that the original game still has some issues that make it difficult to play comfortably and break the gameplay. The opinion of the players is very important to us, so we have already started to fix these problems and present you our new update!

What's new in the Update 1.22

 The selection of Anti-Aliasing method is added in the settings, now the game supports no antialiasing option, FXAA and TemporalAA
 Temporal AA mode of Anti-Aliasing is set by default. This mode enables better picture quality, completely removes a flickering, but if for some reason it does not suit you, it is possible to change it in the game options.
 The option Temporal Upsample for the mode Temporal AA is added
 The preset Light Zombies Only (no Archers) is added to the training mode - the same as Light Zombies Only preset, but without archers
 The preset Zombies Only (no Archers) is added added to the training mode - the same as Zombies Only preset, but without archers
 The campaigns from the Mod Shop are now displayed in the campaign carousel in the main menu
 Pulling the firearm from the slots is fixed. Now the firearm is always taken out only by the handle.
 Pulling the shields from the slots is fixed. Now the shields are always taken out only by the handle.
 Pulling the daggers from the slots is fixed. Now the daggers are always taken out only by the handle.
 It is now possible to enable the controller's haptic effect back when it was disabled.
We are thankful for your feedback, it is very important for further improvement of our game. You can always send all the problems and suggestions to the email address ag@deeptypegames.com or in our Discord. Thank you and stay in touch!

notes.title: Alpha-testing of Hellsplit: Arena 1.2 Mods Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/097dcd22105345d22f3caf4a11c95dfa67a71af5.png

Hello, dear Friends! 👋

We are back again and we are happy to share wonderful news with you! 🥳 Today we are one step closer to probably the most long-awaited update of our game - Update 1.2! We are launching alpha-testing of the new update 1.2, and this means that the testers team from among our players will already get access to the first mods created for our game. Special thanks to those modders who managed to prepare their releases for today's update. At launch, a limited amount of content will be available, but this is just the beginning and the game store will be constantly updated with new works!

Let's share some technical details: players will be able to install mods in a couple of ways at once.
1️⃣ The first and the main one is Mod Workshop build-it in the game. Choose, download and install mods directly from the game! Currently we are using the mod.io service to interact with mods online, and the testers who got access to the alpha version today will need to have a mod.io account to download mods. Fortunately, you do not need to sign up namely on the site, this can be done directly from the game by simply indicating your email and inserting the verification code. In the near future we will make an optional link to a mod.io account and you will be able to download your favorite mods without any registration.

2️⃣ At the same time, if you have another favorite site for downloading mods (for example, nexusmods) - the game now supports manual installation of mods!

❗ By the way, if you are not yet a member of the tester team, but want to try mods right now, then it's high time to join our Discord and apply for joining the tester group!

Thank you all for your patience and understanding. Today alpha-testing of our most anticipated update begins, and the final release is just round the corner! Stay in touch!

Hello, dear friends! 👋 

We are glad to see you again and today we have two good news at once!

As you know this year we have dedicated all our time to the development and integration of user generated content in our game, simply speaking - Mods! We are actively improving and polishing our game's basics, developing tools for content creation and thinking over convenient ways of interaction with mods for both, players and modders! And the first good news is that the mods will appear already in the next game update which will be released under the number 1.2! We'll make a more detailed announcement of this update later, but already now we want to say that this will be a major update with a lot of new content, the release will include both, the updated game and the Hellsplit: Workbench - our own modding tool, where everyone of you will be able to try yourself as the creator of your own unique content!

notes.title: Hellsplit: Arena "Daggers" Update 1.18 released
notes.notes:
Hello, dear friends!

As you already know, we are now actively working on the development of our Mod SDK, but before it is released we wanted to please you with another update. Something that you have asked us for a long time has happened - the Daggers  ⚔ are added to the game! Being available from the very beginning of the game, having a light weight and rather low striking power, they become at the same time an ultimative weapon due to their lightness and easiness to use. Thanks to its sharp blade, daggers can easily stab the enemy's ringmail, as well as the skeletons skulls, what makes them a perfect helper in the battle against the armored enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/69c19b9daed017b88786a74d611675fd95df94ca.gif

Moreover, we have tried to make it as convenient as possible and added new mechanics to the game - interception of the weapon on the fly. All that you need to do is to push the button of the secondary action when gripping the weapon with one hand. Now the two most lightweighted swords have the same abilities - Short Sword и Nordic Sword and also Francisca axe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/eb1ec66ed4eafb64815b8a87efe0b0bb39c51f19.gif

In this update we paid special attention to the stabbing system (largely it is because we wanted to expand the possibilities of our system for the forthcoming Mod Kit). E.g. multi-stabbing has been added to the game, which allows you to literally pin the enemy with the sword or arrows to the wall and determine his fate. In general, the stabbing system has become more stable and comfortable. Hopefully you will like this update! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901292/62371d62abcfd349928e17dd9c23d42895b7b5d2.gif

Changes

Dagger is added
Stiletto is added
Sai is added
Double Sai is added
Rondel Dagger is added
Kukri is added
Kris is added
Stabbing system is improved, behaviour of the weapon and enemies when stabbing is made more stable
Multi-stabbings are added, now it is possible to pin the enemy to the wall or pierce several enemies with one weapon.
Context actions for Short Sword and Nordic Sword are added
Vulnerable areas of the armored enemies are edited, now it is easier to pierce them
Behaviour of the stabbed enemies is fixed, now they cannot get up while you are holding the weapon.
The weight of the skeletons is changed, now they can be easily manipulated when gripped
The cage on the Torture map is fixed

Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Hellsplit: Arena Update 1.17 released
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=oW1WLoZw33k;full][/previewyoutube]
Dear friends, brave warriors and fighters of the undead!

A lot of time has passed since our previous update, we have been working hard on improving the core mechanics of the game and increasing its interactivity, and now we are glad to present you our new update - 1.17! In this update, we have added a completely new type of weapon to the game - firearms. Pistol, Hand Cannon, Duplet, Rifle and Sniper Rifle are now at your disposal. These types of weapons will be a good help in the battle with the undead in addition to the classic swords, axes and hammers!

Moreover, we have added a new core mechanic to the game - climbing. Its potential is difficult to fully realize on existing maps so far, but its availability opens up great opportunities for further updates of our game.

In each of our updates, we try not just to add small improvements to the game, but to introduce truly new game mechanics, the main goal of which is to prepare the game for subsequent major changes that will significantly change the gameplay, gaming process and give players a completely new experience. And this will come very soon! Thank you for being with us!

Changes

Climbing mechanics is added
The existed maps are modified to use climbing
New map is added: Bridge
New weapon category is added: firearms
Pistol is added
Hand cannon is added
Duplet is added
Rifle is added
Sniper rifle is added
Cartridges are added: bullets
Cartridges are added: buckshot
Training levels selection interface was changed
Enemies now take damage from fall from height
Player now takes damage from fall from height
Hit with the quiver now causes damage
Quiver now flies up when falling to the ground
Minimal and maximal size of the hand by the avatar calibration is limited
Fixed bug after the update 1.16 of impossibility to buy bows and arrows during the campaign

notes.title: Hellsplit: Arena Update 1.16 released
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=yP7fUBHCGbg;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello, dear friends! We are pleased to announce that the long-awaited update 1.16 is now available! We have done a great deal of work to make Hellsplit: Arena even more interesting, uncommon and exciting.

For a long time you fought bravely against the undeads using only melee weapons, warriors. We wanted to help you in this area for quite some time, and finally added the first ranged weapon to the game - 5 types of bows and arrows. However, the undeads have not wasted their time as they have reinforced their ranks with new units – zombie-archers, who are ready to fire you back at any time. Good luck in the battle!

In addition, we took a lot of other wishes received from the players into account and fixed a number of problems. One of the major changes that may seem to be invisible at first glance is the rework of weapon and object systems, which will allow you creating new weapons and objects in a much faster and more intuitive way, making our game one step closer to the integration of user-generated content.

We have also implemented shadows and textures quality graphics settings into the game. As a result, you will have the opportunity to get even more beautiful picture due to the indirect shadows, or improve game performance by enabling lower settings.

We listen to all your wishes and continue our active game development. We will also be very happy to see you in our Discord community! Thank you for your support!

* For correct work of the campaign and purchase of new weapons in the altar, we recommend you to start the campaign again. To do this, you need to create a new profile and start a new campaign. *

Changes

New type of weapon is added: bows and arrows. As before, they are available in the altar in both, campaign and training modes
New ammunition is added: light arrows, heavy arrows and explosive arrows
New types of zombie are added: archer-civilian and archer-soldier
New map Creek is added
The order of the bonus rounds is slightly changed; the new map is integrated into the campaign
The option of shadow quality setting is added
The ability to enable the indirect shadows for characters is added
The option of texture resolution setting is added
Lighting quality and detailing on most maps is improved
Overall game performance is improved
New NPCs are added - fish and the boar
Skeletons body HP is decreased
The interaction with weapons with two-handed grip is improved
Weapon pulling mechanics is speeded up
Working with the interactive items is improved
Zombies react to the bell sound at Cemetery map
It is now possible to return weapons in the altar on HTC Vive and WMR
The shield no longer gets stuck in your hand when letting go
Many other minor fixes and changes

Our recommendation to those who's already completed the campaign would sound rather simple - try it again! :)

notes.title: Hellsplit: Arena Update 1.14 released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Halloween has come and gone, but we are still working hard and want to present you our new update 1.14! Here are some new features to keep you all occupied:
First off, kicking has become a lot more comfortable, now it is directed depending on where your HMD is positioned, rather then being on a 360 axis at a single height. The pumpkin bombs from Halloween are new and improved (design and sensitivity wise that is) and here to stay to demolish the undead. Cutting a zombie in half now leaves some delightful physics based guts hanging out of both sides while not having almost any effect on performance! Lastly, we have a new way to brutality execute the undead, first you could rip their hearts out, but now you can rip their heads off!
These are the major additions to 1.14 but be sure to take a look at the changelog below, stay safe slayers!

Changes

 Kicks are made in the look direction and inflict damage now
 New option of zombie defeating: head ripping
 Now zombie's guts fall out while slicing him in a half
 New hybrid motion mode for HTC Vive is added
 New hands contextual animation is added 
 Avatar's emotions are added
 Black bombs are added
 Bug of enemies animation during the explosion is fixed
 Sounds of fallen shatters of the objects are added
 Lighting of the map "Fort" is fixed
 Halloween stuff is removed
